method: Read each candidate tool implementation (not keyword-only). Candidates were first widened by ML/GPU-related symbols, then each function body and callees were inspected for device selection, training/inference path, and whether CPU is viable.

tiers.requires_gpu: Designed for GPU; docs/defaults assume CUDA, or workload is impractical on CPU for normal use.
tiers.prefers_gpu: Uses PyTorch/HF/DeepPurpose and will take CUDA when available, but the coded path can run on CPU (often slowly).
tiers.cpu_forced_or_default: Touches a DL library but this wrapper hardcodes or defaults to CPU.
tiers.not_gpu: Matched the candidate net by coincidence (docs/URLs/names); implementation is CPU numerical / file prep / remote HTTP only.

requires_gpu.name: generate_embeddings_with_state
requires_gpu.why: Docstring requires 10GB+ GPU for SE-600M; code checks torch.cuda and warns CPU is very slow; embedding forward pass sized for VRAM.

requires_gpu.name: generate_transcriptformer_embeddings
requires_gpu.why: Default num_gpus=1 and precision 16-mixed; prints GPU requirement; inference CLI is multi-GPU oriented.

requires_gpu.name: get_uce_embeddings_scRNA
requires_gpu.why: Runs UCE via Hugging Face Accelerate Accelerator; large single-cell foundation embedding model, not a CPU path in this wrapper.

requires_gpu.name: create_scvi_embeddings_scRNA
requires_gpu.why: Trains scvi.model.SCVI then SCANVI (PyTorch Lightning). No CPU-only shortcut; training is the hot path.

requires_gpu.name: unsupervised_celltype_transfer_between_scRNA_datasets
requires_gpu.why: Default SCANVI_POPV=True; popV annotate_data trains/uses scVI/scANVI-style models. Other flags (RF/SVM/CellTypist) can be CPU, but default path is GPU-oriented DL.

requires_gpu.name: segment_with_nn_unet
requires_gpu.why: Calls nnunet.inference.predict.predict_from_folder with default model_type=3d_fullres and mixed_precision=True; torch-based 3D segmentation, practically GPU.

requires_gpu.name: run_diffdock_with_smiles
requires_gpu.why: Default use_gpu=True; docker run --gpus device=N for DiffDock inference. use_gpu=False is possible but not the intended path.

requires_gpu.name: annotate_celltype_with_panhumanpy
requires_gpu.why: Spawns panhumanpy_env and runs AzimuthNN (neural annotation + optional ANN embeddings). Separate conda env with DL stack; not a pure CPU numeric tool.

prefers_gpu.name: generate_gene_embeddings_with_ESM_models
prefers_gpu.why: Loads fair-esm, device = cuda if available else cpu, tensors .to(device). Default esm2_t6_8M can run on CPU; larger ESM models in comments need high VRAM.

prefers_gpu.name: predict_admet_properties
prefers_gpu.why: DeepPurpose CompoundPred pretrained models; library moves models to cuda when available, else CPU.

prefers_gpu.name: predict_binding_affinity_protein_1d_sequence
prefers_gpu.why: DeepPurpose DTI pretrained models; same cuda-if-available behavior as ADMET.

prefers_gpu.name: query_chatnt
prefers_gpu.why: transformers pipeline(InstaDeepAI/ChatNT); device default -1 (CPU), caller can pass a CUDA device id.

prefers_gpu.name: bayesian_finemapping_with_deep_vi
prefers_gpu.why: Small custom torch.nn variational net trained in-process; no cuda selection, runs on default torch device (CPU unless global cuda tensors). Feasible on x86 CPU.

cpu_forced_or_default.name: segment_cells_with_deep_learning
cpu_forced_or_default.why: CellposeModel(..., gpu=False) hardcoded — CPU only in this wrapper.

cpu_forced_or_default.name: create_harmony_embeddings_scRNA
cpu_forced_or_default.why: Calls harmony.harmonize(...) without use_gpu=True; harmony-pytorch defaults use_gpu=False → CPU.

cpu_forced_or_default.name: prepare_input_for_nnunet
cpu_forced_or_default.why: Only rearranges/prepares NIfTI folders for nnUNet; no model inference.

cpu_forced_or_default.name: map_to_ima_interpret_scRNA
cpu_forced_or_default.why: sklearn NearestNeighbors on existing X_uce embeddings; requires prior UCE run, but this step itself is CPU.

not_gpu_false_positives.name: analyze_enzyme_kinetics_assay
not_gpu_false_positives.why: Curve fitting / dose-response numerics; no DL.

not_gpu_false_positives.name: predict_protein_disorder_regions
not_gpu_false_positives.why: IUPred2A HTTP/local sequence scoring; not GPU.

not_gpu_false_positives.name: advanced_web_search_claude
not_gpu_false_positives.why: Anthropic web_search API; remote LLM, not local GPU compute.

not_gpu_false_positives.name: perform_mwas_cyp2c19_metabolizer_status
not_gpu_false_positives.why: Stats / association on methylation tables; CPU.

not_gpu_false_positives.name: reconstruct_3d_face_from_mri
not_gpu_false_positives.why: nibabel + SimpleITK + skimage marching cubes; CPU.

scheduling_hint.x86_cpu_ok_including_optional_dl: All remaining MCP tools, plus prefers_gpu and cpu_forced_or_default lists above.
scheduling_hint.note: If splitting pods: put requires_gpu on the aarch64/CUDA machine; run the rest on x86 without GPU. prefers_gpu can stay on x86 unless latency/VRAM becomes an issue (especially larger ESM models).
